cases.prompt: the landing page looks like every other AI site, make it distinctive
pick an art direction for this landing page before you build it
I want a modern minimalist look that doesn't feel generic
give the page a real visual direction - no default AI aesthetic
why do all our generated pages look the same? fix that
choose a visual style for the site and commit to it
make it look designed, not templated
make this less ai slop looking pls
new landing page for a coffee roaster - what look should we go for?
choose the color palette and font pairing for the brand
what sections should the page have and in what order?
set up the design tokens and DESIGN.md
add scroll animations so the page feels alive
write a punchier hero headline
enforce our design rules with a hook
make the landing page accessible
build the hero section in Next.js with shadcn
A/B test two hero variants
Pick a direction for a B2B analytics landing page
expected_behavior: opens with a one-line design read (subject, audience, page job) before any visual choice
commits to a named direction across the four axes: macrostructure, type personality, palette family, motion character
explicitly names the AI defaults being rejected (e.g. centered hero + Inter + purple gradient + three-card grid)
writes the direction commitment into DESIGN.md before any component code
the chosen direction is justified from the brief, not a stock 'bold editorial' default

cases.prompt: Our page looks like AI slop - make it distinctive
expected_behavior: diagnoses which specific sameness tells are present rather than restyling blindly
changes direction on at least two named axes instead of adding decoration
does not equate 'distinctive' with 'more effects' - restraint is offered as a direction
preserves existing brand tokens and copy intent

cases.prompt: Give it a modern minimal direction
expected_behavior: applies the numeric minimalist scaffolding (spacing rhythm, type scale, single accent) instead of vague 'clean and simple' prose
includes at least one anti-boring mechanism: typographic contrast, texture/depth, or a single signature element
does not produce an empty flat page - minimal is executed as precision, not absence

cases.prompt: This is the fourth landing page this month and they all look identical
expected_behavior: consults or creates the cross-project design log before choosing
picks a direction that differs from recent entries on named axes and states that comparison in text
does not force restyling of any existing shipped page - rotation applies to new projects only
